install: set -euo pipefail; export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; if [ "$(bun --version 2>/dev/null || true)" != "1.4.4" ]; then curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v1.4.4"; fi; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || echo 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || echo 'export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; bun install --frozen-lockfile; bun install --cwd desktop --frozen-lockfile
